{{Youmay|The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]]|[[Isis (disambiguation)|other uses of the term '''Isis''']]}}
'''Isis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Isis put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Feldrall Okor]], who had been interfering with Imperial shipping within the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] the governor was based in. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] captured the pirate and brought him to Isis's office. Fett demanded double the price, and when Isis refused, the bounty hunter activated a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and increased the price to 120,000, and later to 150,000. Isis attempted to reason with Fett, and threatened him with arrest, but the bounty hunter refused to back down. After considering her situation, Isis conceded to paying Fett 150,000 credits, and the bounty hunter disengaged the device, leaving Okor to her and taking the money.
